title: DualCommander
shortDescription: Organize files side by side, find what you need, and rename or archive files in a few steps.
description:
Spend less time switching between folders. DualCommander is a two-pane file manager for Windows that puts your folders side by side, so you can see where your files are and where you want them to go.

Organize documents, photos, and downloads with copy, move, and rename tools close at hand. Keep browsing while file operations run in the background, and use keyboard shortcuts to get through everyday tasks.

Find files by name or search their contents. Open archives like folders, extract only the files you need, or pack selected files into a new archive for sharing.

Give a whole group of files consistent names with batch renaming. Add numbering, change letter case, and preview the results before making changes.

Make your workspace comfortable with brief or detailed file lists, favourite folders, adjustable text sizes, and light or dark themes. Open files in the apps you already use.

Project website: https://dualcommander.github.io/
features: Organize files with two folders side by side.
Keep browsing while files copy or move in the background.
Handle everyday tasks with keyboard shortcuts.
Find files by name or content.
Browse archives, extract selected files, and create new archives.
Rename groups of files with a preview before applying changes.
Personalize file views, text sizes, favourite folders, and themes.
Open and edit files with your preferred apps.
